integrity: The Euler form and graph interpretation are attributed to the originating article. The claimed new result is the exact all-prime positivity and inertia classification. Finite numerical and exact-arithmetic tests corroborate the universal proof and do not substitute for it. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only odd-prime cyclic groups with both nonzero weights; formal quadratic-form positivity, not geometric realizability of all multiplicities; no composite-order or noncyclic classification.
title: Prime-order cyclic quotient Euler forms: a complete positivity classification
